verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI documents defining custom schemas to extract structured JSON, plus CSS, XPath, and LLM-based structured extraction. So a developer can supply a schema and get JSON back. The evidence does not show that a standard JSON Schema is accepted, or that the output is validated against it. Missing for 10: explicit JSON Schema input support, documented guarantees of schema-conformant output (especially for LLM extraction), API/request examples, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pass a JSON schema so the API returns structured data matching that schema

citations.quote: Schema Definition: Define custom schemas for extracting structured JSON from repetitive patterns.
LLM-Driven Extraction: Supports all LLMs (open-source and proprietary) for structured data extraction.
Structured Extraction: Parse repeated patterns with CSS, XPath, or LLM-based extraction.
